Hi Ashlee / Anya —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on availability. Based on what you sent, we can run a condensed virtual loop next week. High-level: 4 interview slots (~45m each) + 30m debrief. Would you prefer Tue 11/10 or Thu 11/12?

Proposed times (PST):
- Option A (Tue 11/10): 9:30–11:30am + 12:00–13:30 (includes breaks and debrief)
- Option B (Thu 11/12): 10:00–12:30 + 13:00–14:30

Quick note on sequencing:
1) Coding exercise (live pair) — 45m
2) System design — 45m
3) Product / PM-style behavioral — 45m
4) Team fit / bar-raiser — 45m
+ 30m hiring manager + interviewers debrief (we'll assign an owner once the panel confirms)

Laura / Naomi / Karthik — commenting on sequencing and buffers would be helpful. Ashlee / Anya, let me know which option works and any constraints.

Attachments: interview-runbook.pdf (outline + scoring rubric)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks — Thu 11/12 works best for me (I have a prior commitment on Tue morning). Option B looks good. I do better when the coding exercise is earlier in the day, so the order you proposed is fine. A short lunch break between the second and third slot would be great.

Also: I have a 60-minute timezone overlap limit in the afternoon (I can do until 16:00 EST).

Best,

Thanks Naomi — this looks close. Two requests:

1) Can we run the system design before the product interview? I want the candidate to have the big-architecture conversation before PM-style questions; it helps the PM interviewer ground their questions. So swap slots 2 and 3 (system design at 11:00, product at 13:00).

2) Please add a 15-minute post-loop breathing window after the debrief (some of us need to prep for back-to-back afternoon meetings). So shift debrief to 15:15–15:45 and reserve 15:45–16:00 private buffer.

Debrief owner: Laura Bennett (I will own hiring manager summary). Technical aggregator: Jonas Weber — Jonas, can you confirm you’ll collate coding + design scores and post the summary to the drive doc?

Also: Karthik, if you can run the bar-raiser portion or suggest another senior IC, that would be ideal.

Laura
Head of Product | Redwood Inference

Works for me — I'll own the technical aggregation. Quick preference note: for the coding slot, I'd like to run a 10-minute warmup (simple problem) before the 35-minute pair-programming task so we can ramp the candidate in. Naomi — can you add a 10m pre-call window from 9:50–10:00 (candidate-facing) to the coding invite and add a private 10m before that for interviewer notes (9:40–9:50)? If the scheduler UI doesn't support multiple blocks easily, we can include the warmup as a 10m addendum in the same 45m invite and just mark the first 10 as warmup.

Also, Marissa: would you prefer system design material in advance (1 pager) or live prompt? I can draft a short prompt and share by EOD tomorrow.

Jonas
